primary.title: Can you continue your PPF after moving abroad? Rules for existing account holders who become NRIs and foreign citizens
primary.summary: PPF accounts in India offer attractive returns and tax benefits. NRIs can continue contributing to existing accounts but lose benefits if they acquire foreign citizenship. Details here.
